name: Training the Beast

angles.text: As a hunter, you move beyond capturing beasts to build a lasting, disciplined bond. Feed, revive, and train your companion.
As an Alliance hunter in Elwynn Forest, you can learn the basics of beast handling from veteran woodsmen like Isaac Chan in Goldshire.

faq.answer: Isaac Chan is a lifelong woodsman who lives in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. He knows wildlife and wilderness survival, and teaches novice hunters to guide, feed, revive, and teach abilities to their animal companions.
Hunters learn to care for a tamed beast and maintain their bond. Isaac Chan teaches them to feed their companion, revive it if it falls in battle, and teach it new combat abilities.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Training the Beast?

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Isaac Chan lives in Goldshire, the central township of Elwynn Forest, south of Northshire Valley and southwest of Stormwind City.
faq.q: Where can Isaac Chan be found?

faq.answer: Isaac Chan teaches the basics of caring for and training an animal companion. You learn to feed your beast, revive it if it falls in combat, and teach it new abilities as it grows alongside you.
faq.q: What skills does Isaac Chan teach?

faq.answer: Isaac Chan teaches hunters humility before the wild. He asks them to honor nature's balance and live in awe of the world around them, so their bond with a beast rests on stewardship rather than exploitation.
faq.q: Why does Isaac Chan remind hunters to respect nature?

aliases: is training the beast hunter only
faq.answer: Hunters who can already tame beasts seek Isaac Chan's woodland discipline to sustain and train an animal companion.

sections.body: You seek Isaac Chan, an experienced woodsman in Goldshire, to learn how to train your beast. A tamed creature needs care and discipline before it can become a steady ally. Without Chan's guidance, your companion may remain unruly in the wilderness.
sections.title: The Responsibilities of the Hunt

sections.body: Isaac Chan teaches you to care for your animal companion. You learn to feed it and revive it if it falls in battle. He also teaches commands that help it fight, and reminds you that power over wildlife calls for respect. Honor nature's balance and live in awe of the world around you.
sections.title: A Woodsman's Guidance

summary: In Goldshire, Training the Beast shows young hunters how to care for a tamed companion. Isaac Chan teaches them to feed and revive their beasts, then train them for life at their side.
attribution: In-game quest text: Training the Beast
